title: Use Robot Selection Go-to to send an AGV (not in a task) to a selected square
summary: Use the OptiSweep Robot Selection “Go-to” function to recover quickly when an AGV is not currently in a task: select the AGV, choose “Go to,” select a destination square, and confirm. In the example shown, after the tote is removed, the AGV picks up a new task.
when_to_use: Use when you need to recover quickly by sending an AGV that is not in a task to a chosen destination square using the Robot Selection “Go to” function.
not_for: Do not use Go-to for an AGV that is currently in a task (the source explicitly limits Go-to to AGVs not in a task).
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the Robot Selection “Go to” recovery by selecting the correct AGV, selecting the destination square, and confirming the command.
access_or_tools_needed: Go-to function controls: “Go to”, square selection, “Confirm”

access_required: Access to the OptiSweep interface area that contains “Robot Selection” and the “Go to” function
system_preconditions: Target vehicle is an AGV that is not in a task

visual_references.description: Robot Selection Go-to function UI and the example text: “An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square… Select an AGV… Select Go to… Select which square… Select Confirm… Example… drop it off at the hospital… AGV will pickup a new task once it's tote has been removed.”

steps.title: Confirm the target vehicle is an AGV that is not in a task
steps.purpose: Ensure the Go-to function is applicable (it is limited to AGVs not currently in a task).
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep Robot Selection area, identify the target AGV and verify it is not in a task before using Go-to.
steps.expected_result: The selected target is an AGV that is not in a task, making it eligible for Go-to to a destination square.
steps.healthy_condition: The AGV you intend to recover is eligible for Go-to because it is not currently in a task.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV is in a task, so Go-to should not be applied.

actions.label: Verify AGV task state
actions.exact_action: Confirm the target vehicle is an AGV that is not in a task

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the Go-to function cannot be applied because the AGV is in a task (source explicitly limits Go-to to AGVs not in a task).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square.”
“Robot Selection Go-to function… An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square…”

steps.title: Select the AGV in Robot Selection
steps.purpose: Choose the specific AGV that will receive the Go-to destination command.
steps.instruction: In the OptiSweep Robot Selection area, select the AGV you want to recover.
steps.expected_result: The intended AGV is selected in Robot Selection (so the subsequent “Go to” action applies to the correct AGV).
steps.healthy_condition: The Robot Selection UI reflects that the correct AGV is selected.
steps.failure_condition: A different AGV is selected than intended, causing the Go-to command to target the wrong vehicle.

steps.title: Select the “Go to” function
steps.purpose: Switch from AGV selection to the Go-to destination assignment workflow.
steps.instruction: After selecting the AGV, choose the “Go to” function in the Robot Selection workflow.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to function is active for the selected AGV (so you can choose a destination square).
steps.healthy_condition: The UI proceeds to destination square selection after “Go to” is selected.
steps.failure_condition: The UI does not enter the Go-to destination selection flow for the selected AGV.

steps.title: Select the destination square
steps.purpose: Choose where the AGV should navigate as part of the recovery.
steps.instruction: Select which square you want the AGV to go to (use the square selection shown in the Go-to workflow).
steps.expected_result: A destination square is selected as the Go-to target for the chosen AGV.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI indicates the chosen square as the destination for the selected AGV.
steps.failure_condition: No square (or an unintended square) is selected before confirmation.

actions.label: Select square destination
actions.exact_action: Select which square you want the AGV to go to

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “3. Select which square you want the AGV to go to”

steps.title: Select “Confirm” to send the Go-to command
steps.purpose: Execute the Go-to command for the selected AGV to the selected square.
steps.instruction: Select “Confirm” to send the Go-to command.
steps.expected_result: The Go-to command is confirmed and the AGV is sent to the selected square.
steps.healthy_condition: After confirmation, the AGV begins moving toward the selected destination square.
steps.failure_condition: The AGV does not proceed to the selected square after confirmation.
stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the AGV does not proceed to the selected square.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “An AGV not in a task can be sent to any square… Select Confirm…”

steps.title: Verify the recovery example outcome after tote removal
steps.purpose: Confirm the recovery behavior described in the example: after tote removal, the AGV picks up a new task.
steps.instruction: In the provided recovery example, after the tote is removed, observe that the AGV picks up a new task.
steps.expected_result: The AGV picks up a new task once its tote has been removed.
steps.healthy_condition: After tote removal, the AGV transitions to having a new task to execute (i.e., it is no longer waiting without a task in the example scenario).
steps.failure_condition: After tote removal, the AGV does not pick up a new task.

actions.label: Observe AGV task pickup after tote removal
actions.exact_action: Observe that the AGV will pickup a new task once it's tote has been removed

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the AGV does not pick up a new task after the tote is removed (as described in the example).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “The AGV will pickup a new task once it's tote has been removed.”

success_criteria: Go-to is applied to an AGV that is not in a task.
After confirming, the AGV is sent to the selected square.
In the example, after the tote is removed, the AGV picks up a new task.
healthy_conditions: Go-to is only used when the AGV is not in a task.
After “Confirm,” the AGV proceeds toward the selected destination square.
After tote removal (in the example), the AGV picks up a new task.
failure_conditions: Go-to cannot be applied because the AGV is in a task.
The AGV does not proceed to the selected square.
After tote removal, the AGV does not pick up a new task.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if Go-to cannot be applied due to the AGV being in a task.
Escalate if the AGV does not proceed to the selected square after “Confirm.”
Escalate if the AGV does not pick up a new task after the tote is removed (per the example).
